title: [Excel Reports] Handle an apostrophe in the No. on the Vendor and Customer Top List
summary: Excel reports for top vendor and customer lists now handle apostrophes in account numbers correctly by properly escaping quotes in filter expressions.
key_points: Fixed NavInvalidFilterExpressionException when vendor or customer numbers contain apostrophes
Escape helper now doubles internal quotes and uses Text parameter type instead of Code
Single-value buffer lookups converted to SetRange for exact comparison instead of filter parsing
Added tests verifying exports with apostrophes at start, middle, and end of account numbers
No breaking changes; local helper modification affects only these reports
